TITLE: UAE and Saudi Arabia report drone incidents as Iran war deadlock drags on
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-17 (updated 2026-05-18 05:27)
AUTHOR: Tala Ramadan
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY:
- UAE drone strike caused fire at Barakah nuclear plant Sunday
- Saudi Arabia intercepted 3 drones that entered from IRAQI AIRSPACE
- Saudi Arabia warned it would take necessary operational measures to respond
- UAE MoD: 2 other drones "successfully" dealt with; launched from "western border"
- During Iran conflict, drones have been launched from Iraq toward Gulf countries (Saudi Arabia, Kuwait)
- Iran stepped up attacks on UAE earlier this month after Trump announced naval mission to open Strait of Hormuz (suspended after 48 hours)
- Diplomatic adviser to UAE president: dangerous escalation "whether carried out by the principal perpetrator or one of its proxies"
- Iranian armed forces spokesperson Shekarchi: US would "face new, aggressive, and surprise scenarios"
- Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei: US/Israel "tried to shift the blame for destabilizing energy markets following their unprovoked military aggression against Iran"
- Ebrahim Azizi (Iranian parliament national security committee head, Saturday): Tehran prepared "mechanism to manage traffic through the strait along designated route" — to be unveiled soon
